How did the Census of 1905 differ from previous censuses in the matter of manufacturing establishments?
How does the growth in capitalization rank with that of the other important branches of manufacturing?
What principle was the cause of the origin of the modern company or corporation?
Explain the provisions of a pool.
How were the defects of the pool overcome?
What are the advantages of a trust or combination?
What has been the effect of trusts on prices? On wages?
Name and classify according to product the companies of which the United States Steel Corporation was formed.
What was the number of establishments for the iron and steel industry in the United States in 1880? In 1905? What does this show?
What method was used by the early Germans for extracting the iron from the ore? By the English in 1700? By the early American colonists?
Why was coke used in the smelting of iron ore in England much earlier than in America?
How did the development of railways aid in the preservation of our forests?
What is the puddling process? Why is it necessary?
What process took the place of the puddling process?
What is steel? How is iron obtained by the Bessemer process made into steel?
What is the most important of the textile industries?
Compare the value of textile manufactures in the principal countries of Europe during the period from 1800 to 1896, inclusive, with that of the United States during the same period.
Define textiles. How are they made?
Who invented the spinning jenny? What was its use?
Up until the invention of the water frame, why was the making of cloth entirely from cotton impracticable?
What was the spinning mule? By whom was it invented?
What is the purpose of the cotton gin?
What factors have made cotton the most important textile?
Why is the cotton industry moving toward the South?

p.hi: Manufacturing Industries of the United States.

div.p: Why was manufacturing neglected by the early settlers of the United States?
What manufactories sprang up in the nineteenth century?
Name the four greatest producers of manufactures for exportation.
When was the largest growth of agricultural exports in the United States? Of exports of manufactures?
What articles are the chief requisites of manufacturing?
How do you account for the rapid growth of copper as an export of manufacture?
Illustrate the fact that the United States does not need to invade foreign markets with its manufactures.
Distinguish between the gross value of the factory product of manufactures and the net value of the same.
Compare the growth of the exportation of manufactures with that of the production.
Under what head does the Bureau of Statistics classify boots and shoes; flour; salted meats; illuminating oil; pig iron.
How do concrete and steel supplement each other?
Of what is the standardization of concrete applications indicative?
Give an example showing the durability of the Hennibique construction.
What advantages over the wooden bearing pile has the concrete bearing pile?
How may the resistivity of usual concretes be reinforced?
Explain the use of wales in reinforcing a water front.
How are the bearing piles of a wharf in the tropics made?
Enumerate various uses to which concrete has been put in construction. Pages 333, 334.
What is the problem of the concrete telegraph pole? How may this be overcome?
How is the Corell tie made? The Percival tie?
What part does steel play in the construction of the Gatun Locks of the Panama Canal?
Give an illustration of the use of steel for molding concrete.
Why has it been necessary to put industry on a scientific basis?
Why is chemistry so closely related to the industries?
Tell in your own words the story of the development of the soda industry.
Name three important industries which grew out of the soda industry.
Give an example of how science has led the way for industry.
What are the great achievements before the chemistry of the future?
What was the drawback to the early development of the gas engine?
Why was the suction producer not practical?
What led to the introduction of the pressure producer?
What is the advantage of the down-draft producer?
What is the ideal relative efficiency of the producer-gas plant and the steam plant? The actual relative efficiency?
What defects in producer-gas plants were learned from the inspection in 1908?
Where are the producer-gas plants of England located?
How can the price of power developed from fuel be kept down?
What is the reason for the failure of many cost systems?
Upon what does the efficiency of a workman depend?
What should be used as a standard for the measurement of time?
What effect does the giving of bonuses have on the efficiency of the foreman?
What advantages are gained from having proper time cards for the workmen of a concern?
To be successful, how should efficiency methods be introduced?

p.hi: The Bridge between Labor and Capital.

div.p: What is the chief cause at the bottom of all labor disputes?
When and how was the labor problem brought about?
What three methods of solution are proposed for the present problem of distribution?
In your opinion which method is the best?
What is the central cause of the want of employment?
Show the evil effect of ill-advised charity upon the unemployed.
What does the practice of giving old-age pensions indicate as to the fairness of the distribution of the returns of production?
Name three ways in which the problem of the unemployed can be reduced.
What are the effects of ignorance and indolence upon society?
If employment were remunerative, what would be the results?
What lines of industry should society court?
What are the evils connected with industrial corporations?
Summarize the remedies for the want of employment.

div.head: Transcriber’s Note
div.p: Obvious printing errors, such as backwards, upside down, or partially printed letters, were corrected. The last two lines of the Table of Contents, printed in reverse order, were corrected. Final stops unprinted at the end of sentences were added.
Dialect, obsolete and alternative spellings were left unchanged. Pittsburgh (PA) is spelled without the final “h” throughout the book. Omitted words were not added to the text.

Footnotes in the text were renumbered sequentially and moved to the end of the article in which the anchor occurs. Footnotes within tables were changed to letters and were moved to follow the table in which the anchor occurs. In some tables, a footnote may have more than one anchor; consequently, no link is provided from table footnotes to any anchor.
Wide tables were split for easier viewing on small screens.
